title: Recover a model train as it enters its service siding

verification_methodology.disclosure: Uses the verified 55-mesh IKEA LILLABO train set GLB (Dragonalex, CC BY, 23 maps: S_Locomotive, S_Cart, S_Cistern, S_Rail*, S_RailCurved*) with BEHAVIOR-1K toy_train (zdfhbw) runtime fallback metadata. Locomotive and coupled carriages roll under real MuJoCo rigid-body friction and deceleration along physical rail guides; Panda's 7-DOF arm either waits for measured zero velocity and picks at the live stop coordinate or closes at a fixed scheduled point while the train is still moving, physically derailing it.
